title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 6,551–6,600 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 結合物理化學與烹飪藝術之現代分子美食學

examples.en: Avant-garde molecular gastronomy deconstructs familiar dishes using laboratory physics and chemistry.
examples.zh: 前衛「分子美食學」（Molecular Gastronomy），運用物理化學原理將傳統經典料理大膽解構重組。

examples.en: Food critics travel across Europe to explore the cutting edge of contemporary French gastronomy.
examples.zh: 美食評論家走訪歐洲各地，深入探尋當代法國美食學的最前端浪潮。

examples.en: The university offers an interdisciplinary program examining the cultural history and science of gastronomy.
examples.zh: 這所大學開設跨領域課程，專門探討烹飪美食學的文化歷史與科學成因。

words.definition: 米其林三星頂級烹飪藝術與廚藝美學的

examples.en: The young chef dedicated his youth to mastering traditional and modern culinary techniques.
examples.zh: 年輕主廚將整個青春奉獻於磨練傳統與現代「頂級廚藝美學」（Culinary Arts），追求極致風味。

examples.en: Graduating from a renowned culinary academy opened international career doors for aspiring pastry makers.
examples.zh: 從頂尖廚藝名校畢業，為這群有志成為甜點師的年輕人打開了通往國際伸展台的大門。

examples.en: Taiwan's night markets offer an extraordinarily vibrant culinary landscape celebrated by worldwide tourists.
examples.zh: 台灣夜市擁有無比豐富多元的庶民美食景觀，深受來自世界各地觀光客的熱烈讚譽。

words.definition: 數位高精度恆溫水循環低溫慢煮舒肥機

examples.en: The thermal immersion circulator maintains water temperature within zero point one degree Celsius.
examples.zh: 數位高精度「恆溫水循環舒肥機」（Circulator），將水槽溫度嚴格鎖定在正負零點一度的極限誤差內。

examples.en: Commercial kitchens install heavy-duty water circulators to guarantee uniform cooking throughout large briskets.
examples.zh: 營業用廚房安裝營業級恆溫水流循環機，確保大塊牛胸肉通體受熱完全均勻。

examples.en: Clamp the compact immersion circulator to the side of any stockpot to begin precise sous-vide cooking.
examples.zh: 只要將輕巧的浸入式舒肥棒夾在任何湯鍋邊緣，便能立即展開精準的低溫烹調。

words.definition: 均勻控溫於 56.5°C 之精準舒肥低溫水槽；洗澡

examples.en: Duck breasts cook gently inside the calibrated water bath for two hours until perfectly pink throughout.
examples.zh: 鴨胸肉在攝氏五十六度的「恆溫水槽」（Water Bath）中靜置慢煮兩小時，呈現通體均勻的粉嫩肉質。

examples.en: After a long mountain hike in winter, sinking into a steaming hot spring bath restored her energy.
examples.zh: 冬季經過漫長的山林健行後，浸泡在熱氣騰騰的溫泉浴池中讓她徹底恢復了元氣。

examples.en: Laboratory technicians place chemical test tubes into an ultrasonic water bath to dissolve crystals.
examples.zh: 實驗室技術人員將化學試管浸入超音波恆溫水浴槽中，加速結晶物質溶解。

words.definition: 食品級耐高溫真空密封保鮮袋；小袋

examples.en: Seasoned cuts of wagyu beef are vacuum-sealed inside a food-grade pouch with fresh thyme and butter.
examples.zh: 將調味好的頂級和牛與百里香、發酵奶油一同裝入「食品級真空密封袋」（Pouch）中徹底抽氣封口。

examples.en: The marathon runner carried energy gels inside a waterproof zippered pouch around his waist.
examples.zh: 馬拉松跑者將能量果凍妥善收納在繫於腰間的防潑水拉鍊隨身小袋中。

examples.en: Mother kangaroos shelter their newborn joeys securely within their soft abdominal pouch.
examples.zh: 母袋鼠將剛出生的幼獸安全呵護在柔軟溫暖的腹部育兒袋中。

words.definition: 膠原蛋白完全軟化之入口即化極致口感；質地

examples.en: Low-temperature cooking breaks down tough sinews, yielding an impossibly tender, velvety meat texture.
examples.zh: 低溫慢煮徹底軟化了強韌的肌腱筋膜，營造出令人驚嘆、如絲絨般入口即化的「極致軟嫩口感」（Texture）。

examples.en: Pastry judges evaluate croissants based on outer flake flakiness and buttery interior texture.
examples.zh: 烘焙評審主要依據外層千層的酥脆度與內層濕潤柔軟的質地口感來評分可頌。

examples.en: The coarse woven texture of the linen curtain filters bright afternoon sunshine gently.
examples.zh: 亞麻窗簾粗獷質樸的手工織紋質地，溫和過濾了午後刺眼的烈日陽光。

words.definition: 鑄鐵鍋高溫瞬間梅納反應反向香煎封汁；灼熱的

examples.en: Quick searing in a smoking-hot cast iron skillet produces a flavorful browned surface after sous-vide.
examples.zh: 舒肥完成後，在冒煙的極熱鑄鐵鍋中進行數十秒的快速「高溫香煎」（Searing），瞬間封住肉汁。

examples.en: Firefighters braved searing heat to rescue residents trapped on the burning apartment balcony.
examples.zh: 消防隊員冒著灼熱難耐的高溫烈火，奮勇救出受困在失火公寓陽台上的住戶。

examples.en: The investigative journalist published a searing critique exposing corporate financial fraud.
examples.zh: 調查記者發表了一篇言辭犀利深刻的嚴厲批判報導，揭露這起跨國企業金融詐欺弊案。

words.definition: 焦香誘人氨基酸與還原糖高溫梅納褐變反應；反應

examples.en: High skillet heat triggers the Maillard reaction, generating hundreds of savory, nutty aromatic compounds.
examples.zh: 煎鍋高溫瞬間觸發了神奇的「梅納褐變反應」（Maillard Reaction），釋放出數百種誘人的堅果焦香分子。

examples.en: Her immediate reaction upon receiving the promotion was pure astonishment followed by joyful tears.
examples.zh: 當她接獲升遷通知時，第一時間的真實反應是難以置信的驚喜，隨後流下開心的眼淚。

examples.en: Doctors closely monitored the patient for any allergic reaction after administering the antibiotic injection.
examples.zh: 醫師在施打抗生素針劑後密切觀察患者狀態，以防出現任何急性過敏反應。

words.definition: 牛排表面金黃酥脆焦香誘人之香脆外皮；地殼

examples.en: A deep golden crust forms quickly, locking in the succulent, evenly cooked interior juices.
examples.zh: 牛排表面迅速形成一層深金黃色且香氣四溢的「酥脆焦香外皮」（Crust），牢牢鎖住內層鮮美肉汁。

examples.en: Sourdough bakers pride themselves on baking artisan loaves with blistered, caramelized crusts.
examples.zh: 酸種烘焙師以烤出帶有焦香脆泡、金黃焦化的職人手作歐包脆皮為榮。

examples.en: Geologists study tectonic plate collisions that push continental crust upward into majestic mountain chains.
examples.zh: 地質學家深入研究地殼板塊的劇烈擠壓碰撞，正是這種推力將大陸地殼抬升成雄偉山脈。

words.definition: 海藻酸鈉直接球化成型技術 (人工魚子醬)

examples.en: Spherification encapsulates fruit juices inside translucent gel spheres that burst playfully in the mouth.
examples.zh: 經典「球化成型技術」（Spherification），將鮮美果汁封裝進半透明晶球中，在舌尖帶來趣味爆漿體驗。

examples.en: Ferran Adrià pioneered basic spherification at El Bulli, revolutionizing modern dessert presentations.
examples.zh: 廚藝傳奇名廚費蘭·阿德里亞在鬥牛犬餐廳首創基礎球化技術，徹底顛覆了現代餐點風貌。

examples.en: Mastering direct spherification requires precise measurement of acidity and calcium bath concentration.
examples.zh: 熟練掌握直接球化成型技術，必須精確調控果汁酸鹼度與凝膠鈣化水槽濃度。

words.definition: 褐藻提取之天然無味海藻酸鈉水溶性膠體

examples.en: Dissolving food-grade sodium alginate into puree creates a viscous liquid ready for calcium bath drops.
examples.zh: 將天然褐藻提煉的「海藻酸鈉」（Sodium Alginate）均勻溶於果泥中，即可滴入鈣離子水浴展開反應。

examples.en: Dentists use seaweed-derived alginate impressions to create exact molds of orthodontic patients' teeth.
examples.zh: 牙醫診所利用褐藻海藻酸鈉印模材，為齒列矯正患者精準壓印出全口牙齒模型。

examples.en: Medical manufacturers produce sterile alginate dressings to accelerate wound healing and moisture retention.
examples.zh: 醫療衛材廠商生產無菌海藻酸鹽敷料，以加速患處傷口肉芽生長並長效鎖住濕潤環境。

words.definition: 氯化鈣水浴 (引發聚合物交聯凝膠化反應)；鈣

examples.en: Submerging alginate droplets into a calcium bath triggers instant surface polymerization into a flexible skin.
examples.zh: 將海藻酸鈉滴液沉入「鈣離子水浴」（Calcium Bath），瞬間觸發表面交聯反應形成一層彈性薄膜。

examples.en: Nutritionists recommend fortified soy milk and dark leafy vegetables to maintain daily dietary calcium.
examples.zh: 營養學專家建議攝取高鈣強化豆漿與深綠色蔬菜，以補足每日所需飲食鈣質。

examples.en: Adequate calcium intake during teenage years helps build peak bone mineral density for adulthood.
examples.zh: 青少年時期維持充足的鈣質攝取，有助於成年後累積豐厚強健的骨質密度基石。

words.definition: 咬下一瞬間爆漿爆發之液態芒果珍珠球體；球體

examples.en: Guests spooned up the golden mango sphere, delighted when it burst instantly into liquid nectar.
examples.zh: 賓客用小匙舀起金黃色的芒果「液態珍珠球體」（Sphere），在放入口中咬破的瞬間爆出滿口甘甜蜜汁。

examples.en: Astronomers observed an uncharted planetary sphere revolving around a distant red giant star.
examples.zh: 天文學家觀測到一顆未曾記錄的行星球體，正繞著遙遠的紅巨星規律公轉。

examples.en: The distinguished ambassador maintained immense cultural influence within the diplomatic sphere.
examples.zh: 這位資深外交大使在國際外交舞台與文化交流領域中，始終保持著舉足輕重的影響力。

words.definition: 反向乳酸鈣球化技術 (適用乳酪與含酒精液體)；反向

examples.en: Reverse spherification allows calcium-rich liquids like yogurt and cheese creams to form stable spheres.
examples.zh: 「反向球化技術」（Reverse Spherification），讓富含鈣質的優格、起司乳酪與烈酒也能凝結成穩定的晶球。

examples.en: Shift the vehicle gear into reverse carefully before backing out of the narrow basement parking space.
examples.zh: 在從狹窄的地下室停車位倒車出來前，請謹慎地將排檔桿切換至倒車檔。

examples.en: The supreme court voted to reverse the lower court's decision due to newly presented forensic evidence.
examples.zh: 最高法院在審查了新提出鑑識證據後，表決推翻了地方法院的原判決。

words.definition: 包裹晶瑩果汁之微米級極薄半透彈性凝膠膜；薄膜

examples.en: The microscopic gel membrane is imperceptibly thin, melting away with zero rubbery chewiness.
examples.zh: 包裹液體的「微米級凝膠薄膜」（Membrane）薄如蟬翼，在口中瞬間化開，毫無橡膠般的韌澀咀嚼感。

examples.en: Biological cells regulate nutrient and waste exchange through a selectively permeable lipid membrane.
examples.zh: 生物活細胞透過具有選擇通透性的雙層脂質細胞膜，嚴密調控營養物質與代謝廢物的進出。

examples.en: High-tech waterproof trekking jackets feature a breathable Gore-Tex membrane to repel driving rain.
examples.zh: 高階防水登山防風外套採用高透氣薄膜技術，兼具卓越防水性能與優良排汗透氣感。

words.definition: 零下 196 度超低溫液態氮瞬間極速急凍；氮

examples.en: Chefs pour smoking liquid nitrogen tableside to freeze herbal olive oil creams into crunchy pearls.
examples.zh: 主廚在餐桌旁緩緩傾倒翻騰白煙的「液態氮」（Liquid Nitrogen），將羅勒橄欖油慕斯瞬間凍成香脆珍珠。

examples.en: Nitrogen makes up roughly seventy-eight percent of the air we breathe in Earth's atmosphere.
examples.zh: 在地球的大氣層中，氮氣大約佔據了人類呼吸空氣總體積的百分之七十八。

examples.en: Farmers apply balanced nitrogen fertilizers to stimulate lush vegetative growth in green tea plantations.
examples.zh: 專業茶農施用均衡配方的氮肥，藉以促進高山茶園茶樹枝繁葉茂、嫩芽勃發。

words.definition: 液態氮極速急凍 (完整鎖住食材鮮甜與香氣)；冰凍的

examples.en: Flash freezing at minus 196 degrees prevents cellular damage, preserving pristine herbaceous aromatics.
examples.zh: 零下 196 度的「極速急凍技術」（Flash Freezing），能防止植物細胞膜破裂，完整鎖住新鮮香草的芳香。

examples.en: Mountain hikers bundled up in thermal woolens as the temperature dropped below freezing on the peak.
examples.zh: 隨著主峰氣溫驟降至冰點以下，高山登山客紛紛裹緊保暖羊毛衣物抵禦嚴寒。

examples.en: Commercial fishing trawlers rely on deep freezing chambers to preserve fresh tuna catches during sea voyages.
examples.zh: 遠洋商業漁船仰賴船載深層急凍冷凍庫，在漫長的遠洋作業途中妥善保存現撈黑鮪魚。

words.definition: 極速冷凍消除大冰晶之極致絲滑頂級冰淇淋；水晶

examples.en: Instant freezing creates microscopic ice crystals, yielding an incomparably silky, velvety gelato.
examples.zh: 瞬間極速冷凍徹底消除了粗糙大冰晶，創造出細膩到「微米級冰晶結構」（Microscopic Ice Crystals）的絲滑冰淇淋。

examples.en: The chandelier in the historic ballroom was crafted from hundreds of hand-cut sparkling crystal prisms.
examples.zh: 歷史悠久的國宴宴會廳水晶吊燈，由數百枚手工精密切割的水晶三稜鏡折射出璀璨光芒。

examples.en: Snowflakes form distinct hexagonal ice crystal patterns as moisture freezes high in winter clouds.
examples.zh: 當水氣在冬日高空凍結時，每一片飄落的雪花都會凝結成獨一無二的六角形冰晶圖案。

words.definition: 宛如空氣般輕盈之大豆卵磷脂分子料理泡沫 (Espuma)；泡沫

examples.en: A cloud of lemon-scented culinary foam floats weightlessly atop the pan-seared sea scallop.
examples.zh: 一團散發著清檸香氣、輕如空氣的「分子料理泡沫」（Culinary Foam），輕盈漂浮在香煎生干貝頂端。

examples.en: The barista whipped fresh whole milk into thick, velvety foam to pour latte art onto the cappuccino.
examples.zh: 咖啡師將新鮮全脂鮮奶打發成濃稠細膩的奶泡，在卡布奇諾咖啡表面拉出優雅的心形拉花。

examples.en: Heavy white sea foam coated the sandy beach as turbulent storm waves crashed against the sea wall.
examples.zh: 隨著狂暴的暴風雨巨浪重重拍擊防波堤，厚厚一層雪白的泡沫海浪覆蓋了整片沙灘。

words.definition: 高壓一氧化二氮充氣虹吸發泡槍；虹吸管

examples.en: Pressurizing purees inside a stainless steel cream siphon produces warm, velvety vegetable mousses.
examples.zh: 在不銹鋼「高壓發泡虹吸槍」（Siphon）中注入氧化亞氮氣體，能擠出溫熱細緻、如絲絨般的根芹慕斯。

examples.en: The mechanic used a clear plastic tube to siphon gasoline safely from the old tractor fuel tank.
examples.zh: 技師使用透明塑膠軟管，將老舊農用牽引機油箱裡的殘油安全虹吸抽引出來。

examples.en: Traditional coffee houses brew aromatic morning blends using an elegant glass vacuum siphon pot.
examples.zh: 傳統精緻咖啡館常使用優雅剔透的玻璃雙球真空虹吸壺，手工萃取出香氣馥郁的單品咖啡。

words.definition: 安定不油水分離之奈米級細緻均質乳化醬汁

examples.en: Ultrasonic homogenizers create a silky emulsion of browned butter and fresh yuzu juice.
examples.zh: 超音波均質機將焦化奶油與新鮮柚子汁打成「奈米級安定乳化醬汁」（Emulsion），質地極致絲滑且絕不分層。

examples.en: Mayonnaise is a classic culinary emulsion formed by whisking oil into egg yolk and lemon juice.
examples.zh: 美乃滋是烹飪史上最經典的乳化醬汁之一，由沙拉油慢慢打發融入蛋黃與檸檬汁而成。

examples.en: The dermatologist formulated a soothing hydrating emulsion designed for extremely dry sensitive skin.
examples.zh: 皮膚科醫師研發了一款溫和舒緩的長效保濕乳液，專為極度乾燥敏感的肌膚設計。

words.definition: 天然大豆卵磷脂界面活性天然乳化劑

examples.en: Natural plant emulsifiers bond lipid and water molecules tightly, creating smooth hollandaise sauces.
examples.zh: 天然植物「乳化劑」（Emulsifier），將油脂與水分子緊密鍵結，調製出細膩滑順且久置不析出的荷蘭醬。

examples.en: Ice cream manufacturers incorporate food emulsifiers to maintain smooth consistency during cold storage.
examples.zh: 冰淇淋食品大廠添加天然食品乳化劑，以維持產品在低溫冷凍儲運期間滑順均勻的質地。

examples.en: Without an effective emulsifier, oil and vinegar dressings quickly separate into distinct liquid layers.
examples.zh: 若缺乏合適的乳化助劑，油醋醬在靜置數分鐘後便會迅速分層拆解為油水兩層。

words.definition: 富含磷脂質之天然大豆與向日葵卵磷脂

examples.en: A tiny pinch of sunflower lecithin allows chefs to whip aromatic carrot juice into stable air bubbles.
examples.zh: 僅需加入一小撮「向日葵卵磷脂」（Lecithin），就能用手持攪拌棒將胡蘿蔔汁打發成綿密持久的橘紅泡沫。

examples.en: Chocolate makers blend soy lecithin into molten cocoa to lower viscosity and achieve glossy sheen.
examples.zh: 巧克力工坊在融化的可可漿中混入大豆卵磷脂，以降低稠度並賦予巧克力絲綢般的亮麗光澤。

examples.en: Health stores sell soy lecithin granules as dietary supplements to support healthy brain function.
examples.zh: 保健食品專賣店陳列販售大豆卵磷脂顆粒，作為維護思緒靈活與日常營養補給的膳食補充品。

words.definition: 三仙膠與寒天等天然植物水溶性親水膠體

examples.en: Modern chefs use natural hydrocolloids to modify sauce viscosity without altering pure ingredient flavors.
examples.zh: 現代名廚善用天然「親水膠體」（Hydrocolloids），在完全不稀釋食材原味的前提下隨心所欲調整醬汁濃稠度。

examples.en: Food scientists explore seaweed hydrocolloids as biodegradable packaging alternatives to petroleum plastic.
examples.zh: 食品科學家積極研究海洋紅藻親水膠體，期望開發出能取代傳統石油塑料的生物可分解包裝包材。

examples.en: Hydrocolloids like pectin and locust bean gum stabilize commercial fruit fillings during baking.
examples.zh: 果膠與刺槐豆膠等天然親水膠體，能在高溫烘烤過程中穩定水果派餡料的稠度與形態。

words.definition: 三仙膠黃原膠 (提供高剪切稀化極佳流動感)

examples.en: Xanthan gum suspends herbs evenly throughout vinaigrettes without imparting heavy floury thickness.
examples.zh: 少量「三仙膠」（Xanthan Gum）能讓香草碎粒均勻懸浮在油醋汁中，同時保持清爽如水的純淨流動感。

examples.en: Gluten-free bakeries rely on xanthan gum to provide structural elasticity usually supplied by wheat gluten.
examples.zh: 無麩質專業烘焙坊極度仰賴三仙膠，以取代小麥麵筋在麵團發酵中扮演的結構支撐與彈性。

examples.en: Only half a gram of xanthan powder is required to thicken an entire liter of savory gravy.
examples.zh: 僅需微量的半公克三仙膠粉末，就能恰到好處地增稠整整一公升的美味烤肉原汁肉汁。

words.definition: 耐高溫攝氏八十度不融化之天然紅藻瓊脂洋菜膠

examples.en: Red seaweed agar-agar sets into firm, crystal-clear jellies that stay solid even when served hot.
examples.zh: 萃取自天然紅藻的「瓊脂洋菜膠」（Agar-Agar），能凝結成耐熱八十度的透明晶凍，熱食依然保持固態。

examples.en: Microbiologists pour sterilized agar solution into Petri dishes to cultivate bacterial colonies.
examples.zh: 微生物學家在無菌培養皿中倒入滅菌瓊脂培養基溶液，作為培養細菌菌落的基底。

examples.en: Traditional Asian confectionery shops prepare sweet red bean jelly using natural boiled agar strips.
examples.zh: 傳統日式和菓子老舖使用天然水煮洋菜條，手工熬製凝固口感緊實甘甜的紅豆羊羹。

words.definition: 精準溫控之流體凝膠化與分子麵條塑型工藝

examples.en: Gelification techniques transform concentrated beef broth into translucent, flexible savory noodles.
examples.zh: 精湛的「凝膠塑型工藝」（Gelification），將濃郁牛肉清湯轉化為一根根半透明、具彈性的鹹香分子麵條。

examples.en: Rapid gelification occurs as soon as the warm agar mixture cools below forty degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 一旦溫熱的瓊脂混合液降溫至攝氏四十度以下，便會立即發生迅速的凝膠化固化反應。

examples.en: Modern pastry chefs apply sheet gelification to create delicate fruit films wrapped around mousse cakes.
examples.zh: 現代法式甜點主廚善用薄片凝膠工藝，製作出薄如蟬翼的水果凝凍軟片包裹在慕斯蛋糕外層。

words.definition: 高速離心與冷凍融解之水晶晶瑩清高湯澄清技術

examples.en: Freeze-thaw agar clarification strips cloudiness, producing a broth clear as spring water yet bursting with flavor.
examples.zh: 冷凍融解「瓊脂澄清技術」（Clarification），濾除所有微小懸浮濁質，滴出如山泉般透明卻鮮味爆棚的清高湯。

examples.en: The spokesperson issued a public clarification to correct misunderstandings regarding the company's fiscal report.
examples.zh: 發言人發表了一份公開聲明澄清啟事，以導正大眾對於公司年度財務財報數據的各項誤解。

examples.en: Water treatment plants use sand filtration and chemical clarification to produce potable municipal tap water.
examples.zh: 自來水淨水廠透過石英砂過濾與化學混凝澄清製程，將原水淨化為符合國家安全標準的飲用水。

words.definition: 如琥珀般晶瑩剔透、滴油不沾之法式澄清湯

examples.en: The crystalline tomato consommé arrived glowing like melted gold in a delicate porcelain cup.
examples.zh: 晶瑩剔透的「法式番茄澄清高湯」（Consommé），盛裝在精緻骨瓷杯中，在燈光下泛著如融化黃金般的光芒。

examples.en: Classical French culinary apprentices spend months perfecting clarified beef consommé using egg white rafts.
examples.zh: 傳統法餐學徒必須花費數月苦練，才能純熟掌握利用蛋白餅吸附雜質、澄清牛肉清湯的真功夫。

examples.en: Chilled consommé with diced summer vegetables makes an exceptionally refreshing first course in July.
examples.zh: 冰鎮法式澄清清湯搭配切碎的鮮甜夏令時蔬，在盛夏七月是一道無比開胃清爽的開胃頭盤。

words.definition: 旋轉真空減壓蒸餾濃縮儀 (低溫萃取植物香氣) 的

examples.en: The rotary evaporator distills eucalyptus leaves under vacuum, isolating delicate volatile fragrance.
examples.zh: 「旋轉真空蒸發儀」（Rotary Evaporator），在低溫真空下溫和蒸餾尤加利葉，完美萃取出純淨芬芳精華。

examples.en: Traffic flowed smoothly through the newly constructed four-lane rotary intersection outside the terminal.
examples.zh: 航廈外圍新建的四線道圓環樞紐通車後，尖峰時刻的車流運轉十分順暢無阻。

examples.en: Rotary drilling rigs bore deep into geothermal bedrock to harvest subterranean steam power.
examples.zh: 旋轉鑽井機具一路深鑽進地熱硬岩基岩中，藉以汲取深層地下豐富的高溫地熱蒸汽能源。

words.definition: 廚房實驗室旋轉蒸發器 (分離純化清澈芳香液體)

examples.en: Operating the flash evaporator at room temperature prevents heat from destroying fresh pine aromas.
examples.zh: 在室溫下操作真空「旋轉蒸發器」（Evaporator），能徹底防止高溫破壞新鮮松針中嬌嫩的揮發性芬多精。

examples.en: Technicians checked the evaporator coil on the industrial chiller to ensure optimal refrigeration performance.
examples.zh: 技師仔細檢查大型工業冷凍冰水主機的蒸發器盤管，以確保全場最佳的冷卻製冷效能。

examples.en: Sugar refinery plants boil cane juice in a multi-stage steam evaporator to crystallize molasses.
examples.zh: 現代製糖精煉廠在多級蒸汽蒸發濃縮槽中熬煮甘蔗汁，使糖漿逐步濃縮並析出晶瑩糖晶。

words.definition: 低溫減壓蒸餾完整鎖住之新鮮香草揮發性香氣；香氣

examples.en: Cold-distilled cucumber water releases an intense, pure aroma that awakens the guest's nasal palate.
examples.zh: 低溫蒸餾出的黃瓜純露散發出極致純淨的「清新香氣」（Aroma），瞬間喚醒食客的鼻腔嗅覺感官。

examples.en: Freshly ground roasted coffee beans filled the cozy neighborhood cafe with an irresistible morning aroma.
examples.zh: 現磨現煮的深烘焙咖啡豆，讓整間社區街角咖啡館瀰漫著令人難以抗拒的迷人晨間芳香。

examples.en: Sommelier students learn to identify subtle fruit aromas like blackcurrant and plum in aged red wines.
examples.zh: 侍酒師專業學員努力練習從陳年紅酒中，細細嗅辨出黑醋栗與成熟李子等微妙的果實芳香。

words.definition: 廚房料理專用一萬轉高速離心機 (分離原汁油脂)；離心機

examples.en: Spinning herb purees in the benchtop culinary centrifuge separates dark green chlorophyll from clear sweet nectar.
examples.zh: 在廚房專用「高速離心機」（Centrifuge）中以萬轉旋轉，將香草泥瞬間分離為深綠葉綠素與透明清甜汁液。

examples.en: Blood samples are placed in a clinical centrifuge to separate red blood cells from liquid plasma.
examples.zh: 醫檢人員將患者血液檢體放入臨床離心機中高速旋轉，以將紅血球與淡黃色血漿徹底分層。

examples.en: The aerospace research institute built a human centrifuge to simulate intense gravitational forces during rocket launch.
examples.zh: 航空航天研究所建造了超大型載人離心旋轉機，以模擬火箭升空瞬間航太員承受的強烈超重 G 力。

words.definition: 基於氣味分子化學質譜之食材風味科學搭配學；配對

examples.en: Food pairing algorithms suggest combining white chocolate and caviar because both share trimethylamine molecules.
examples.zh: 「食材科學風味搭配學」（Food Pairing），發現白巧克力與魚子醬因共享三甲胺分子而能碰撞出絕妙和諧。

examples.en: The certified sommelier suggested an impeccable wine pairing of dry Riesling with spicy Sichuan seafood.
examples.zh: 認證侍酒師精準推薦了絕佳的餐酒搭配：以干型麗絲玲白酒佐搭鮮辣濃郁的川味海鮮。

examples.en: Bluetooth pairing between your smartphone and the wireless noise-canceling headphones takes just seconds.
examples.zh: 智慧型手機與抗噪無線耳機之間的藍牙配對連線，只需短短數秒鐘即可順利完成。

words.definition: 食材內部共享之相同揮發性芳香化合物；化合物

examples.en: Strawberries and basil share common aromatic compounds, creating a natural harmony on the dessert plate.
examples.zh: 草莓與羅勒在化學分析上共享了關鍵的「揮發性芳香化合物」（Compounds），在甜點盤中譜出天作之合。

examples.en: Water is a simple chemical compound formed by two hydrogen atoms covalently bonded to one oxygen atom.
examples.zh: 水是由兩個氫原子與一個氧原子以共價鍵緊密鍵合而成的一種最常見化學化合物。

examples.en: The foreign diplomatic staff resided inside a heavily guarded embassy compound downtown.
examples.zh: 外國使館全體外交工作人員，集中居住在市中心戒備森嚴的駐外使領館住宅園區內。

words.definition: 結合視覺、聽覺與嗅覺之主廚多道盲測試吃盛宴；品嚐

examples.en: The eighteen-course sensory tasting menu takes guests on a theatrical culinary journey through the seasons.
examples.zh: 長達十八道菜的「主廚感官品嚐套餐」（Tasting Menu），帶領食客展開一場穿越四季的味覺沉浸式劇場。

examples.en: The boutique winery invited club members to an exclusive cellar tasting of unreleased vintage reserves.
examples.zh: 精品精品酒莊熱情邀請尊榮會員深入地窖，專屬品鑑尚未正式公開上市的珍藏年份限量紅酒。

examples.en: Olive oil tasting requires slurping warm oil off a spoon to coat the tongue and evaluate peppery pungency.
examples.zh: 品鑑特級初榨橄欖油時需要用湯匙吸啜溫熱油液，讓油膜均勻包覆舌面以評估其微辛與果香。

words.definition: 煙霧繚繞如現代雕塑般之戲劇性餐點擺盤藝術；呈現

examples.en: Dramatic presentation featuring chilled dry ice fog turns the seafood course into an ethereal seascape.
examples.zh: 伴隨乾冰白霧繚繞的「戲劇性擺盤藝術」（Presentation），將原本的海鮮料理化為一座如夢似幻的神秘海岸。

examples.en: The marketing director delivered an articulate multimedia presentation to the board of directors.
examples.zh: 行銷總監在董事會全體董事面前，條理分明地進行了一場圖文並茂的年度策略多媒體簡報。

examples.en: Clean and orderly presentation of retail merchandise significantly improves overall boutique sales.
examples.zh: 精品店商品陳列得井然有序且視覺典雅，能顯著提升進店貴賓的整體消費意願與銷售業績。

words.definition: 料理鑷子精準點綴食用金箔與三色堇擺盤工藝

examples.en: Chefs use surgical tweezers for precision plating, placing single micro-greens onto delicate pastry tarts.
examples.zh: 廚師手持精密料理鑷子進行極致講究的「精緻擺盤」（Plating），將微型幼苗一片片點綴在精巧塔皮上。

examples.en: The vintage silver teapot required fresh electro-plating to restore its mirror-like antique luster.
examples.zh: 這只具備百年歷史的古董純銀茶壺需要重新進行精細電鍍，以徹底重現其溫潤如鏡的光澤。

examples.en: Modern restaurants invest in custom ceramic dishware specifically designed to showcase creative plating.
examples.zh: 當代前衛餐廳不惜重金向陶藝名家訂製手工陶盤，專門用以完美烘托主廚獨創的擺盤構圖。

words.definition: 視錯覺假象料理 (看似黑炭實為脆皮黑松露)；假象

examples.en: The edible black coal was a delightful culinary illusion: a crispy cassava puff filled with melted truffle cheese.
examples.zh: 盤中那塊看似燃燒黑炭的物件其實是高超的「視錯覺料理」（Illusion），咬開是濃郁流心的黑松露起司脆球。

examples.en: The desert traveler thought he saw an oasis pool ahead, but it was merely a heat shimmering optical illusion.
examples.zh: 沙漠旅人以為望見了前方波光粼粼的綠洲水源，走近才發現不過是地面熱氣折射出的海市蜃樓錯覺。

examples.en: Do not harbor the dangerous illusion that success in entrepreneurship comes without sleepless sacrifice.
examples.zh: 切莫心存僥倖的危險幻象，以為任何創業上的輝煌成就無需經歷無數不眠之夜的汗水犧牲。

words.definition: 上主菜前喚醒並洗滌味蕾之青檸羅勒雪酪；味蕾

examples.en: A sharp, herbaceous citrus granite serves as an icy palate cleanser between heavy courses.
examples.zh: 一球冰涼酸爽的青檸香草碎冰，在厚重主菜轉換之間扮演著洗滌並喚醒「味蕾敏銳度」（Palate）的關鍵角色。

examples.en: Master blenders develop a refined palate capable of discerning microscopic differences in scotch cask aging.
examples.zh: 首席調酒大師培養出了極其敏銳細緻的品味味覺，能精準洞察威士忌在不同橡木桶陳釀間的細微差別。

examples.en: Spicy chili paste overwhelmed his gentle palate, making it impossible to taste the subtle seafood seasoning.
examples.zh: 辛辣的生辣椒醬完全麻痺了他纖細敏感的味蕾，使他根本無法品嚐出海鮮湯頭中清雅的天然甘甜。

words.definition: 熟成昆布與帕瑪森起司之天然谷氨酸極致鮮味

examples.en: Concentrating aged kombu kelp and sun-dried mushrooms unlocks an overwhelming explosion of deep umami.
examples.zh: 將陳年昆布與日曬香菇濃縮提煉，在舌面上釋放出令人欲罷不能、深沉澎湃的「極致鮮味」（Umami）。

examples.en: Japanese culinary tradition defines umami as the savory fifth taste alongside sweet, sour, salty, and bitter.
examples.zh: 日本傳統料理學界將鮮味定義為獨立於甜、酸、鹹、苦之外的第五種基本味覺層次。

examples.en: Adding a splash of aged fish sauce or fermented paste elevates the underlying umami of braised meats.
examples.zh: 在紅燒燉肉時滴入幾滴老牌陳年純魚露或豆瓣發酵醬，能瞬間昇華肉品深層的天然鮮甘味底蘊。

words.definition: 酸、甜、苦、鮮、脆、滑之極致感官和諧平衡

examples.en: Great dishes achieve a transcendent harmony where acidity, sweetness, and rich fats balance one another.
examples.zh: 真正偉大的傳世名菜，在酸度、甜感、油脂與酥脆之間達到了無懈可擊的「感官和諧平衡」（Harmony）。

examples.en: The four vocalists sang four-part choral harmony that resonated through the Gothic cathedral arches.
examples.zh: 四位優秀聲樂家齊聲演唱四部合唱和聲，純淨和諧的天籟餘音繚繞在哥德式大教堂高聳石拱間。

examples.en: Environmental conservationists strive to live in peaceful harmony with indigenous forest ecosystems.
examples.zh: 自然生態保育志工竭盡心力，長年倡導人類文明與在地原始森林生態體系永續共處的和諧之道。

words.definition: 產地到餐桌二十四節氣嚴選當季在地食材概念

examples.en: The restaurant celebrates strict micro-seasonality, changing its offerings every two weeks as wild mushrooms sprout.
examples.zh: 餐廳嚴格遵循大自然「二十四節氣旬味當季」（Seasonality），隨著深山野菇破土每兩週全面更換菜單。

examples.en: Hotel revenues in ski resort towns experience drastic seasonality between winter peaks and summer lulls.
examples.zh: 位於滑雪度假勝地的小鎮飯店旅宿業營收，在冬季滑雪旺季與夏日淡季之間呈現極其劇烈的季節波動。

examples.en: Cooking in tune with agricultural seasonality ensures produce is harvested at the peak of sweetness and nutrition.
examples.zh: 緊跟大地農時節奏烹調應旬蔬果，能確保每一種當令食材皆在水分最甜美、營養最豐富的巔峰狀態採收。

words.definition: 米其林三星春風化雨、無微不至之款待哲學

examples.en: Flawless dining requires intuitive front-of-house hospitality that anticipates every guest's unspoken desire.
examples.zh: 完美的頂級用餐體驗，仰賴外場團隊「春風化雨的真摯款待」（Hospitality），在客人開口前即洞察每項需求。

examples.en: Taiwanese residents are renowned internationally for their warm, sincere, and helpful hospitality to foreign visitors.
examples.zh: 台灣民眾待人接物溫暖熱情、樂善好施的誠摯好客之道，在國際旅人間樹立了有口皆碑的優良美譽。

examples.en: Graduates with degrees in international hospitality management are recruited by luxury resort chains globally.
examples.zh: 擁有國際餐旅觀光管理碩士學位的高材生，長年受到全球各大頂級五星級連鎖奢華度假村競相爭聘。

words.definition: 透過每道菜餚訴說風土與兒時記憶之說故事藝術

examples.en: Memorable gastronomy is an art of emotional storytelling that evokes childhood memories with every bite.
examples.zh: 令人終生難忘的頂級美饌，是一門動人的「說故事藝術」（Storytelling），用滋味勾起食客心底最溫暖的鄉愁。

examples.en: The indigenous elder used oral storytelling around the hearth fire to preserve tribal history and folklore.
examples.zh: 原住民部落耆老圍坐在營火炭火旁，藉由口述長老的口傳說故事傳統，世代傳承部落歷史與古老神話。

examples.en: Great advertising campaigns rely on compelling brand storytelling rather than aggressive sales slogans.
examples.zh: 真正撼動人心的廣告宣傳行銷企劃，仰賴扣人心弦的品牌情感敘事力，而非廉價刺耳的推銷口號。

words.definition: 顛覆傳統食譜框架之無拘無束廚藝創造力

examples.en: Daring culinary creativity reimagines everyday humble root vegetables into luxurious signature centerpieces.
examples.zh: 大膽無畏的「廚藝創造力」（Creativity），能將最樸實無華的胡蘿蔔與馬鈴薯蛻變為驚豔全場的招牌主菜。

examples.en: Elementary school art teachers nurture spontaneous childhood creativity through clay modeling and finger painting.
examples.zh: 國小美術老師透過陶土揉捏與手繪指印畫，細心呵護並啟發孩子們不受束縛的童真想像創造力。

examples.en: Software engineering thrives on technical creativity to solve bottlenecks with elegant code architecture.
examples.zh: 尖端軟體研發仰賴豐沛的技術創造力，以兼具效能與可讀性的優雅程式碼架構化解關鍵效能瓶頸。

words.definition: 對溫度、秒數與調味分毫未差之極致完美執念

examples.en: The kitchen brigade labors under intense pressure, united in a relentless quest for gastronomic perfection.
examples.zh: 廚房內全體廚師在高壓節奏下緊密協同，全心全意投入對「極致美食完美境界」（Perfection）的永恆追尋。

examples.en: The virtuoso pianist practiced twenty hours weekly, striving for technical perfection in every cadence.
examples.zh: 這位享譽國際的鋼琴巨匠每週苦練琴藝二十個小時以上，在每一個樂句終止式中苛求分毫不差的技術精準度。

examples.en: Demanding absolute perfection from inexperienced apprentices can stifle motivation and provoke anxiety.
examples.zh: 對初出茅廬的新手學徒強求百分之百的無瑕完美，往往容易扼殺其學習主動性並引發過度焦慮。

words.definition: 入口瞬間靈魂昇華、淚光閃爍之純粹感官狂喜

examples.en: Tasting the caramelized roasted fig paired with goat cheese foam triggered pure sensory ecstasy.
examples.zh: 嚐到焦糖烤無花果搭配溫羊乳酪泡沫的瞬間，口腔中爆發出令靈魂震撼昇華的「純粹感官狂喜」（Ecstasy）。

examples.en: The stadium erupted in ecstatic cheering when the underdog striker scored the winning goal in stoppage time.
examples.zh: 當不被看好的黑馬前鋒在傷停補時最後一分鐘踢進致勝球時，整座十萬人體育場爆發出近乎瘋狂的狂喜歡呼。

examples.en: Listening to the live philharmonic performance of Beethoven's Ninth Symphony brought tears of joyful ecstasy.
examples.zh: 現場親耳聆聽愛樂管弦樂團現場演奏貝多芬第九號交響曲，那種澎湃崇高的音樂美感令人感動到淚流滿面。

words.definition: 洗滌身心、終生難忘之頂級多元感官心靈盛宴；盛宴

examples.en: An evening at the three-star restaurant is far more than a meal; it is a multi-sensory spiritual feast.
examples.zh: 在米其林三星餐廳度過的一個夜晚遠不只是一頓飯，更是一場洗滌身心的「多元感官心靈盛宴」（Feast）。

examples.en: Extended family members gathered on Lunar New Year's Eve to feast on dumplings, steamed fish, and hotpot.
examples.zh: 家族內親老小在除夕夜齊聚老家客廳圍爐團聚，開懷大啖水餃、清蒸石斑魚與豐盛暖胃的團圓火鍋。

examples.en: Our eyes feasted upon the sweeping panoramic vistas of the snow-covered alpine mountain range.
examples.zh: 登上峰頂那一刻，我們的雙眼盡情飽覽眼前那連綿起伏、壯闊無比的白雪覆蓋阿爾卑斯群峰全景。

words.definition: 廚藝大師將平凡食材點化為傳奇的餐桌魔法；魔法

examples.en: Great cooking is true alchemy—a timeless magic that connects human hearts across cultural boundaries.
examples.zh: 偉大的烹飪是真正的現代煉金術——一種能跨越語言與文化隔閡、深深溫暖人心的「餐桌魔法」（Magic）。

examples.en: The street magician captivated the crowd by pulling fluttering white doves from an empty silk handkerchief.
examples.zh: 街頭魔術師從一條空無一物的絲質手帕中憑空變出拍翅飛翔的白鴿，讓駐足圍觀的大批群眾讚嘆稱奇。

examples.en: Watching the sunrise illuminate mountain mist felt like witness to ancient natural magic.
examples.zh: 站在山嶺看著晨曦金色朝陽穿透層層山嵐雲霧，那一刻彷彿親眼目睹了天地間古老神聖的大自然魔法。
